body:
Hi builder,

A new bounty is live on Superteam Earn: Build and Demo a Mermail Agent Skill.

Total prizes: 500 USDC — 1st: 250, 2nd: 100, 3rd: 50, plus 2x 50 USDC bonus.

To enter, submit before October 9, 2026:
- Submit a link to your demo video (2-5 minutes, showing the skill end to end)
- Submit a link to your public GitHub repo with the skill package
- Include a SKILL.md following the official template
- Include a short write-up of what the skill does and how to run the demo

Judging criteria: originality of the skill, working demo, code quality, and documentation clarity.

Winners announced October 11, 2026.

Good luck!
— Superteam Earn (SIMULATED FIXTURE — not a real email)
subject: [Bounty] Build and Demo a Mermail Agent Skill — 500 USDC
